description: This file defines the CustomView class for vtiger CRM, handling custom view configurations, retrieval of view details, filters, columns, and related functionalities. It includes methods for managing user permissions, fetching filters, criteria JS, SQL generation for filters, and module-specific utilities.

classes.name: CustomView
classes.description: Represents customizable views for modules in vtiger CRM, providing functionality to manage, retrieve, and filter views, including handling user permissions, filters, columns, and generating filter SQL queries.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Retrieves meta information about a specific module, caching it for efficiency.

methods.name: getViewId
methods.description: Determines the current view ID for a module based on session, default, or request parameters, ensuring user permissions.

methods.name: getViewIdByName
methods.description: Fetches the view ID associated with a particular view name within a module.

methods.name: getCustomViewByCvid
methods.description: Retrieves details of a custom view given its ID, including default and set metrics flags.

methods.name: getCustomViewCombo
methods.description: Generates an HTML select options string for available views of a module, marking the selected view.

methods.name: getColumnsListbyBlock
methods.description: Returns list of columns for a given module and block, considering user permissions and profile settings.

methods.name: getModuleColumnsList
methods.description: Gets list of columns organized by blocks for a module’s custom view configuration.

methods.name: getColumnsListByCvid
methods.description: Returns column list for a specific custom view ID in a structured array.

methods.name: getStdCriteriaByModule
methods.description: Fetches standard criteria fields for filtering a module.

methods.name: getStdFilterCriteria
methods.description: Provides standard filter options like today, this week, etc., in array format.

methods.name: getCriteriaJS
methods.description: Generates JavaScript code for setting date filters dynamically based on selection.

methods.name: getStdFilterByCvid
methods.description: Retrieves filter conditions (start/end date) for a given custom view ID.

methods.name: getAdvFilterByCvid
methods.description: Fetches advanced filter groups and conditions for a specific custom view.

methods.name: isFieldPresent_ByColumnTable
methods.description: Checks if a specific field exists in a given table, utilizing a cache for performance.

methods.name: getCvColumnListSQL
methods.description: Constructs an SQL column list string for a custom view ID, supporting special cases.

methods.name: getCVStdFilterSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL for standard filter conditions based on view filters.

methods.name: getCVAdvFilterSQL
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions for advanced filters with grouping, though not used currently.

methods.name: getRealValues
methods.description: Returns SQL fragment with proper comparison operator and escape sequences for filter criteria.

methods.name: getSalesRelatedName
methods.description: Builds SQL condition to match related module names for filter criteria.

methods.name: getAdvComparator
methods.description: Provides SQL comparison expressions based on filter operation (e.g., equals, like, between).

methods.name: getDateforStdFilterBytype
methods.description: Returns start and end date array based on standard filter type such as today, yesterday, this week, etc.

methods.name: getModifiedCvListQuery
methods.description: Constructs a customized SQL list query for a given view ID, module, and base list query, appending filters.

methods.name: getMetricsCvListQuery
methods.description: Generates a SQL query to count records for a specific custom view and module.

methods.name: getCustomActionDetails
methods.description: Fetches custom action details associated with a custom view ID.

methods.name: getCustomViewModuleInfo
methods.description: Sets and retrieves block information for a module, considering specific filtering of blocks.

methods.name: getStatusAndUserid
methods.description: Returns the status and user ID associated with a custom view ID, uses caching.

methods.name: isPermittedCustomView
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to view or access a specific custom view, based on status, ownership, and roles.

methods.name: isPermittedChangeStatus
methods.description: Determines if the current user can change the status of a custom view, providing the new status and label.
